items.title: City quality from a competitive cost base
items.subtitle: Underlying profit before tax
items.content:
Lower competition in our markets means there is less upward pressure on salaries, allowing us to offer greater value for money for our clients. 
 
 Operating outside of major city centres contributes to reduced property costs, and provides a more sustainable work-life balance for our colleagues.
